parent_objective: design a fair paper-route L0/L1/L2/L3 controlled comparison panel before any ranking or self-ID claim
blocked_by: M2021 routes from bounded public diagnostic evidence to controlled comparison design because source-kind singleton blocks direct ranking
supersedes: direct ranking from M2020 diagnostic tables

public_gates: M2022 must design but not execute the controlled comparison panel
M2022 must use the paper-route governing plans as constraints
M2022 must define controller families L0 L1 L2 L3 and reset/truncated controls
M2022 must define source-rich task families and holdout rules
M2022 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: converts bounded M2020 diagnostic signal into an executable fair-comparison panel specification without running new experiments
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design artifact only; no driver performance mechanism ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if the design allows controller ranking from M2020 public diagnostics
stop if controller families do not share the same deployable action and input contract
stop if source-rich task families or holdout discipline are omitted
stop if next execution route is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to design repair if fairness or holdout requirements are incomplete
route to branch synthesis if the design cannot avoid local public-gate overfit
route to implementation only after the design artifact is complete
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2021 routes bounded diagnostic evidence to controlled comparison design

admission_evidence: M2021 audits M2020 as bounded diagnostic evidence sufficient to justify fair-comparison design but not direct ranking
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2022 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for implementation or design audit
next_stage_criteria: fairness and holdout rules are specified
next implementation or audit route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2022 is design-only; it must explicitly plan current-frame and finite-window controls so future self-ID claims cannot be substituted by current-response evidence.
history_necessity_tests: Design wrong/delayed/mismatched history gates only for source-rich tasks.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design artifact for future experiments; no execution in M2022.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: The design must allow finite-window/current-response to win and must preserve negative or conditional self-ID as valid outcomes.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares a new controlled-comparison evidence type instead of extending public diagnostic slices
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can define the evidence required for engineering driver feedback history-conditioned control recurrent-belief advantage or self-ID rejection
must_synthesize_if: M2022 cannot define an executable fair panel
M2022 proposes another no-rerun public diagnostic extension
M2022 omits source-rich task families or holdout discipline

hypothesis: A design-only milestone can convert M2021 bounded diagnostic evidence into a fair paper-route controlled comparison panel without overclaiming public diagnostics.
success_criteria: controller families L0 L1 L2 L3 and reset/truncated controls are specified
source-rich task families and holdout rules are specified
claim gates and negative-result policy are explicit
no rerun ranking finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: source-rich task families or holdout rules are omitted
ranking or paper-level claims are made
decision_rule: M2022 passes if it produces a controlled comparison panel design that preserves fairness, holdout discipline, and claim boundaries.
